english.title: Fail to wear a pass within a security restricted area - Liverpool Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed, when not a bona fide airline passenger, to wear a pass issued to you by or on behalf of Liverpool Airport Limited so that it was reasonably visible at all times in a security restricted area at Liverpool John Lennon Airport, without first obtaining the permission of Liverpool Airport Limited to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2(1)(a) and 4(17) of the Liverpool John Lennon Airport Byelaws 2022.
english.pointstoprove:
